sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Tiara is an obtainable Unit in the game. She is a young girl of holy and demonic descent. She was taken in by Michele on a mission to defeat the Ten-Winged Tormentor.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Tiara's age when she was first introduced was 24 years old.
- Tiara mentions that she has a demon father and a mother that is a goddess.
